race.comment: HILILY HILILY HILO (8) has not raced since a decent debut over this distance at Bendigo in May when beaten just over three lengths. Placed in a recent jump-out. Won't find this as tough as the last hit-out so she looks a great chance to open the account. INCOHERENT (9) settled in a forward position then tried hard but found one better over this course and distance last start. Progressive mare from the Hayes stable who looks ready to win at her fourth career run. DRAMATIC DREAM (1) has been very good at both runs to date, the latest offering a closing second over 1200m at Warrnambool. Nicely drawn and the extra 100m looks perfect at this stage. ZERCARDY (4) travelled midfield then worked to the line steadily last start over 1200m at The Bool. Blinkers go on and he looks in need of this sort of trip now. HELLICA (7) went fast but was swamped late first-up over 1400m at Cranbourne. Fitter and should prove tough to catch.
